title: Black Death: read the reports
hook: Can dated reports reveal a single precise infection route?

predict.question: Do these checkpoints establish every transmission path?

frames.heading: Central Asian record
frames.text: Memorial stones near Issyk-Kul record plague deaths.

frames.heading: Western Eurasia
frames.text: Evidence places plague around the Black Sea and Mediterranean.

reveal: These dots show dated evidence, not a proven chain of infections. Central Asian memorials, biological evidence and London’s records illuminate different parts of the pandemic. Historians debate its origins and pathways. A sequence of reports cannot establish who infected whom.
limit: Report locations and broad regions only; no simulated infection front or blame.
